CYBER THREAT INTELLIGENCE REPORT 2026
Organization X detected a ransomware campaign on 15 August 2026.
The attack exploited CVE-2026-4418 in Identity Gateway.

RECOMMENDED MITIGATION ACTIONS
Deploy patch 2.4.1 immediately and reset affected user credentials.
